items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I think the idea came from Kenny Clarke and later with Max Roach.

ctx.x: to the drummer all the time. He used to go through a little dance. And as he would go through this dance, in certain places where the band had certain things, he would make a break, and whenever he would break, Art Blakey would catch him with the drums, like a dancer. This is where this drummer's thing called dropping bombs really began to get popular. Art wasn't the first one to do it, but I think it sort of came on with him because he was in this big band. I think the idea came from Kenny Clarke and later with…

But anyway, that was the beginning... Once Art caught on to what was happening, then he didn't look back. He just learned what was happening in the band and went on and dominated, you know, the way a good drummer should do.
